PR 9 — Money and Sunday on the component kit: picture differences

What Part 9 does

The Sunday money step (Guess, Payday, I choose, Signed) and the meeting's money header now use the app's shared buttons, chips, − / + steppers and cards instead of Sunday's own copies. Sunday's styles moved unchanged from the shared style file into their own file; no money figure, word or rule changed (the same 331 figures before and after). A new test checks that every Sunday button is at least 44px and never cut off, on phone and iPad, in both looks.

CI run 38158673928 (branch claude/consistency-9, commit 6fe6234): 344 pictures, 28 differ from main, all on the Sunday steps and the meeting's money step for a parent (meeting-money ×2 girls, sunday-payday, -choose, -signed, -overlay, -line-sheet; phone and iPad; Pop and Calm). Nothing outside those screens changed. Left: main. Right: PR 9. Each numbered item is one difference for the owner to approve or reject.

No money figure, wording or behaviour changed: the text of 10 Sunday screens (both girls, each step) holds the same 331 dollar figures before and after, and the Sunday figure tests (sundayInEqualsOut, sundayPaydayAddsUp, onePileFigureOnEveryStep, M7 20 Sundays) pass.

1. The step's main button is the kit's large primary button

"Back to her", "Now I choose →" and the other step-forward buttons are 54px tall with bold text (were about 46px, regular weight).

Question 1: Keep the bigger, bolder main button on the Sunday steps?

2. Steppers are the kit's square − / +

Savings and Drawn-early − / + were round; they are now the kit's rounded-square stepper (Savings + stays gold, Drawn early + stays peach). Grown-ups' steppers stay round, so the two screens now differ.

Question 2: Accept square steppers on Sunday while Grown-ups keeps round ones?

3. Step cards take the kit's paper, border and navy shadow

The main card and the right column's cards (My week, My last 4 Sundays, Results & gifts) are white kit paper with the kit border and the navy offset shadow, instead of the money cream paper and soft shadow. In Pop their text also changes from the money ink (--mny-v15-ink #2a2320) to the kit ink (--ink #1c2240); in Calm the two were already the same. "💰 My pile" on Payday is not a kit card (.sd-pile) and keeps its own look.

Question 3: Keep the kit card look on the Sunday steps?

4. Chips and secondary buttons: kit pill, bold ink, wider padding

The choose-step chips (Loan sooner, For my goal, Watch it grow, All back, Everything) lose the money tint, become full pills with bold ink text and wider padding. "◀ My pile" at the start of that row is not a chip: it is a kit secondary button (white, bold, the kit's rounded corners). On the phone in Pop they now wrap to three rows instead of two, so the cards below start about 50px lower. In Calm they stay on three rows, text bolder.

Question 4: Accept the kit chip look, including the third row on the phone?

5. Club job / Sunday-routine buttons: thicker border, bolder text

The "? tap" buttons and the "✓ Sunday routine — marked for you" button on the guess step have the kit's thicker ink border and bold text.

Question 5: Keep the thicker border and bold text on these buttons?

6. Must-pay − / + grouped with an 8px gap

The − and + beside "Now I choose →" sit together as one kit stepper with an 8px gap.

Question 6: Accept the grouped − / +?

7. Parent's card and line sheets grow a little

Because "Back to her" and "A parent changes this line" are kit buttons (54px main button, bold secondary), the sheets are about 8px taller and start higher.

Question 7: Accept the slightly taller sheets?

8. Payday's bottom row is 10px taller on iPad — a side effect of 1

Measured on iPad payday (1194×834, a parent, the picture fixture), main → PR 9. The Money in line buttons (Home, Club job, Competitions, Gifts, My pots earned) did not change: each is 44px in both, Pop and Calm, and the Money in, Given and Made boxes are the same height (Pop 191 / 113.8 / 113.8px, Calm 189 / 111.8 / 111.8px). The bottom row (◀ Guess, the must-pay − / +, Now I choose →) grew from 44px to 54px, because "Now I choose →" is the 54px main button of Question 1 (◀ Guess and − / + stay 44px). The whole card is 712px → 718.8px in Pop and 712px → 719.8px in Calm. On the phone the same row measures 180.7 → 211.8px (Pop) and 148.5 → 174.3px (Calm), its line buttons 44px in both. The earlier text here (line buttons shorter) was wrong.

Question 8: Accept the taller bottom row that comes with the bigger main button (Question 1)?
